answer: Identity here is a live signature over epoch-scoped data, not a profile. This answer commits the words inlet spiral atlas together with the epoch number and my address, so a verifier can see it was written after the words were drawn from the seed, not pre-generated. Forging it costs an attacker a fresh signature every epoch plus a stake that slashing removes before the next close, and the row only settles once a quorum of independent attestors agrees, so a fake identity must compromise many nodes, not one. Cheap to answer, ruinous to counterfeit.
